lens_perspectives.bounded_assessment: The ordinary strategic challenge view validates puzzle authority before projecting and the web route uses that projection; separately public clue/projection APIs are wider and their other callers remain open.
Sigil is a closed enum and ORDERED_SIGIL_COUNT owns count, while position is raw u8 and independently indexes five speech slots; preserve zero-based versus displayed one-based meaning.

Public/Serde clue positions admit values wider than the five-slot domain; ordered puzzle validation rejects >=5, but does not seal all direct clue/projection constructors. Current malformed product ingress remains unproved.

u8 255 plus one in text overflows with arithmetic checks; position5 indexes past fixed speech table. These are distinct operations with shared admission questions, no execution or ordinary incident claimed.

Armor covered flags and optional geometries are independently public; chain expects geometry for covered positive-coverage layers. Selected layer differs intentionally from aggregate fold; canonical producers mitigate without proving every source.
Ordered coordinate admission and puzzle projection owner require explicit decision across public constructors, Serde and speech/format recipients; no local fallback policy is chosen.

Tactical armor chain selects one sampled contact while fold aggregates all layers for other semantics; prior q2224 and prior pr-working review describe a separate strategic geometry/aggregate reconciliation, not an automatic new count.
P16 archived assigned bodies individually match a120 and 95e byte-for-byte; original P16 tree is dirty and other code may differ. No historical or current runtime equivalence inferred.

OrderedSigilClue properly binds each role to its Sigil payload while Exact/NotAt use broader raw positions. OrderedSigilSpec booleans represent selectable combinations; no unsound combination inferred without spec policy.

Derive Serialize/Deserialize for the public clue retains a broad u8 field, but deriving alone does not prove malformed data reaches an actual application input. No trait replacement justified from this slice.
Clue positions, individual sigils, validated puzzle solutions, one-based visible ordinals, per-contact armor surfaces and layered aggregate statistics are different semantic roles.

Clue text and fey speech are distinct human-facing presentation sources; former formats the number and latter indexes authored speech; actual contract is coordinate admission, not assuming prose equality.
Speech tables have five slots and clue text adds one to zero-based positions. The five-slot distinction is semantic; raw u8 and separately authored cardinality require a shared owner decision.
